5.

FURTHER TO : ARREST OF MALE CHINESE IN POSSESSION
OF AN AUTO. PISTOL AND 12 ROUNDS OF AMMUNITION.

Acting on the instructions of the D.C.(Crime),
the case involving the arrest of Seong Kyech San was
handed over to this branch for further investigation
on the 9th Sept. 1940.

In accordance with further instructions received
a summary of the evidence obtained against the
arrested man has been compiled, and is attached hereto.

On the 11th Sept. 1940 Shinkenko No. 837 signed
by the Provost Marshal of the Japanese Gendarmerie re-
questing that the arrested man be handed over to them
for trial on the grounds of being an agent of the
Chungking Government.

A conclusive evidence has been obtained to
assassinate one Tsang Teh Hsiang (張德祥) an employee
of the "Shanghai Municipality General Labour Union
of the Reformed Government", there is no alternative
but to hand him over to the Japanese Gendarmerie.

The intended victim Tsang Teh Hsiang, has
ignored the existence of the Shanghai Municipal Police
and refuses to co-operate in this case.

5.

续报：逮捕一名持有自动手枪及12发子弹的中国男子。

根据罪案组副总监的指示，涉及逮捕 Seong Kyech San（音译）的案件于1940年9月9日移交本组作进一步调查。

根据随后收到的指示，已编制针对被捕男子的证据摘要，并附于此。

1940年9月11日，收到由日本宪兵队纠察长签署的申肯科（Shinkenko）第837号函件，以该被捕男子为重庆政府特工为由，要求将其移交给日方审判。

已获取确凿证据，证明其意图刺杀“维新政府上海市总工会”雇员张德祥，除将其移交给日本宪兵队外，别无他法。

预定受害人张德祥无视上海工部局警务处的存在，并拒绝在此案中予以合作。

D.S.I. Gibson.

Sir,

On the 29-8-40 a notice was inserted in the
Central China Daily News by Tsang Teh Hsiang.
The translation of the notice reads:-
"I have participated in the peace movement in
accordance with the principle of our Chief Wang in
advocating peace and opposition to communism. My
efforts in leading our labour friends in the printing
trade in supporting this movement should receive
sympathy from all brethren and people. Instead,
however, some leaders made some plan to hurt me,
but fortunately the plot was discovered beforehand
and the culprit was arrested on the spot, while I
escaped unscathed. As all my relatives and friends
have been enquiring about me, I feel very grateful.
Should anybody want to see me on important matters,
please come to the Shanghai Municipality General Labour
Union, Lane 95/10 Edinburgh Road."

J. Gibson
D. S. I.

In the 27-8-40 detectives endeavoured to locate the
intended victim of the assassination, Tsang Ah Ziang,
through enquiries at the Commercial Press Branch Works
at 1110 Gordon Road.
It was learned that Tsang Ah Ziang is registered
on the employees roll but actually performs no work
in the Commercial Press being a member of the Standing
Committee of the Commercial Press Workers Mutual Aid
Society.
He infrequently attends the works at 1110 Gordon
Road but it was stated that every morning between 9 a.m.
and 10 a.m. he visits the office of the Mutual Aid
Society at Lane 45/10 Amoy Road.
This address was visited but Tsang Ah Ziang was
absent. Subsequent further enquiries elicited that he
resides on Robinson Road, O.Q.L., but so far all efforts
to locate this person for questioning have proved
unsuccessful.
The following information regarding the Commercial
Press Employees Mutual Aid Society was received from
Special Branch detectives:-
* The Commercial Press Employees' Mutual Aid
Society (商務書館同人互助會), c/o Lane 43, 10 Amoy Road, was
formed by workers at the workshops of the Press prior to
1938, with the following as members of the Standing

PRIVATE
Supt. Yue An King,
Louza Police Station.
Sir,

At 9.20 a.m. on 25-8-40, an arrest was effected by
Police Search Party attached to your station at Laou Za
Jau near Amoy Road, the arrested person being one of our
Squad members named "Seong". This Squad have come to
Shanghai under the confidential order from the Central
Government to perform the work of exterminating traitors.
Due to our comrade Seong's own carelessness he could not
evade your search party who apprehended him.

However, our comrade Seong's loyalty, courage and
patriotism would, undoubtedly, meet with your praise.

We, therefore, venture to offer you this letter with
the request that you, for the sake of protecting patriots,
be specially kind to the arrested man Seong, and dispose
of him leniently.

Thanking you for your favour, and this case will be
reported to our superior Officer.

The Central Squad for the Exterminating
of Traitors, Stationed Shanghai.
25-8-40.

The arrested man is named:
Seong Kyeh San, native of
Che-ki, Chekiang, printer,
having a pistol in his possession.

Enquiries proceeding.

J. Gibson
D. S. I.

Sgn. Det. A/C.

岳安京（Yue An King，音译）巡长，
老闸捕房。
先生，

1940年8月25日上午9时20分，贵捕房附属警察搜查队在厦门路附近的老闸桥实施逮捕，被捕者系我队队员，名为“Seong”。本队奉中央政府密令来沪，执行肃清汉奸之任务。因我同志 Seong 自身疏忽，未能避开贵方搜查队而被捕。

然而，我同志 Seong 之忠诚、勇敢及爱国精神，无疑将赢得阁下之赞誉。

因此，我们冒昧致函，恳请阁下出于保护爱国志士之目的，对被捕者 Seong 特别宽待，并从轻处理。

感谢阁下之恩惠，此案将上报我方上级长官。

驻沪肃清汉奸总队。
1940年8月25日。

Sir,
At 6.30 a.m. 26-8-40 detectives with the assistance
of the French Police, kept observation at the Great
World, S.C., but the accomplice of Soong Yoch San did
not attend the meeting place.
Soong Yoch San also was escorted to Amoy Road where
observation was maintained from 9.30 a.m. to 10.20 a.m.
in order to locate the person who was to be assassinated.
This man was not located. Enquiries then were made
at the Tah Nyue Printing Shop, 361 Kiukiang Road, where
Soong Yoch San, according to his statement, had an
accommodation address.
The Tah Nyue Printing Shop is a small business
operated by one, Zee Pao Sung(徐宝生).
Zee Pao Sung denied that he had provided an
accommodation address for Soong Yoch San.
He, however, informed detectives that he had known
Soong Yoch San for several years and has met him
frequently during that period; the time elapsing between
each meeting never exceeding one month.
From Zee Pao Sung, it also was ascertained that
the accused, Soong Yoch San, is employed in the Kwang
Yih Printing Company, Lane 299/6 Tatung Road.
This address was visited and the master, Pao Kwei
Young(包桂荣), stated to detectives that Soong Yoch
San has been in his employ for several years. Previous
to the hostilities the printing business was carried on
at Ward Road, and shortly after the commencement of the

先生，
1940年8月26日上午6时30分，侦探在法国警察协助下，在公共租界大世界进行监视，但宋玉山的同伙未出现在会面地点。
宋玉山也被护送至厦门路，从上午9时30分至10时20分在那里进行监视，以定位将被刺杀之人。
未找到此人。随后在九江路361号泰悦印刷所进行查询，据宋玉山供述，那是他的通信地址。
泰悦印刷所是一家由徐宝生经营的小型企业。
徐宝生否认曾为宋玉山提供通信地址。
但他告知侦探，他认识宋玉山已有数年，在此期间经常见面；每次见面的间隔时间从未超过一个月。
从徐宝生处还查明，被告宋玉山受雇于大通路6弄299号的光益印刷公司。
侦探前往该地址，老板包桂荣向侦探表示，宋玉山已在他手下工作数年。战事之前，印刷业务在华德路进行，开战后不久便迁至现址。

两名中国男子，分别称为施（Tai）和俞（Ma），宋玉山与他们两人在法租界霞飞路121号合租一个房间约九个月。

在法国警察的协助下，侦探前往被告位于霞飞路121号的住所。
该房屋的主要承租人赵锡代证实，被告和两名朋友已占用楼上前房近一年，该房间

Seong Yock San admitted that the photograph was
that of the person whom he and his accomplices had
intended to assassinate and that the plan drawn on the
back of the picture is a plan of Amoy Road and vicinity
showing details in connection with the proposed crime.
No other documents or weapons were found in the
room. Detectives then visited the Commercial Press
Printing Dept. at 694 Bubbling Well Road.
Inquiries ascertained that the wanted man, Mah
Tsin Ching (葛永青), had been in regular employment
there for over three years but that he had not appeared
for work since 24-8-40 p.m.
Detectives then were led by the accused to the
home of Mah Tsin Ching at 1684/68 Bubbling Well Road.
There it was ascertained that Mah Tsin Ching had left
the house on 25-8-40 a.m. and had not returned.
Mah Hiang Sz (葛蒋氏), 40, Xiangying, F/Female,
the paramour of the wanted man was brought to the
pages.zh:
2/3。

最初由宋玉山租用。
自1940年8月24日晚以来，三名住客均未返回该房间。
对房间的搜查发现了一条腰带和一个皮袋，宋玉山承认是其所有物。皮袋内装有数张被告的照片，以及一张从较大照片上剪下的中国男子照片。
在该中国男子照片的背面绘制了一张道路示意图。
宋玉山承认，该照片是他和同伙意图刺杀之人的照片，画在照片背面的平面图是厦门路及其周边地区的地图，显示了与预谋犯罪有关的细节。
房间内未发现其他文件或武器。侦探随后前往静安寺路694号商务印书馆印刷部。
经查询查明，被通缉者葛永青（Mah Tsin Ching，注：此处英文拼写与前文万永清不同，但中文名为葛永青，依原文翻译）已在那里定期工作超过三年，但自1940年8月24日晚以来一直未上班。
随后，被告带领侦探前往葛永青位于静安寺路68弄1684号的住所。
在那里查明，葛永青已于1940年8月25日上午离开家，尚未返回。
葛蒋氏（Mah Hiang Sz，音译），40岁，乡营（Xiangying，音译）人，女，系被通缉者的情妇，被带至

pages.en:
2/4.

station for enquiries as it is suspected she may have
knowledge of the where-abouts of Mah Yuin Ching.
Detectives have been posted at 1664/62 Bubbling
Well Road to arrest Mah Yuin Ching in the event of
his return.
The female, Mah Ziang Sz, denies knowledge of the
whereabouts of Mah Yuin Ching. She recognised the accused
as having been a frequent visitor to Mah Yuin Ching but
states she does not know the basis of their association.
She is being detained temporarily pending further
enquiries.
Enquiries regarding the seized photograph were
made at the Commercial Press, Nanki Road, as the result
of additional information elicited from Seong Yoh San.
The photograph was identified as that of one, Tsang
Ah Siang(張福祥), employed as an ordinary workman
at one of the Commercial Press works on Gordon Road near
Robinson Road.
Tsang Ah Siang could not be contacted on 26-8-49
but will be located on 27-8-49 for enquiries.
Information now has been received from the A.I.G.
that the seized pistol was licensed on behalf of the
Shanghai City Government Authorities by the French
Police on 24-1-31. The pistol has no further record.
At 7 p.m. 26-8-49 the master of the printing shop
at 209/6 Taitung Road, Tan Hock Seng, informed detectives
that as a result of the enquiries made he, on the de-
parture of detectives, had examined a drawer in the
desk where Seong Yoh San had worked, and had discovered
pages.zh:
2/4.

前往警局接受问询，因怀疑其可能知晓马玉清（Mah Yuin Ching）的下落。
侦探已部署在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1664/62号，以便在马玉清返回时将其逮捕。
女子马张氏（Mah Ziang Sz）否认知晓马玉清的下落。她认出被告曾是马玉清的常客，但称不知晓他们交往的基础。
她正被暂时拘留，以待进一步调查。

根据从宋耀山（Seong Yoh San）处获得的补充信息，在南京路商务印书馆就查获的照片进行了查询。
该照片被确认为张阿祥（Tsang Ah Siang，張福祥）所有，他在靠近罗宾森路（Robinson Road）的戈登路（Gordon Road）商务印书馆某工厂担任普通工人。
1949年8月26日未能联系到张阿祥，但将于1949年8月27日找到他进行问询。

现接助理总监（A.I.G.）通知，查获的手枪系法国警察于1931年1月24日代表上海市政府当局核发执照。该手枪无其他记录。

1949年8月26日晚7时，泰东路（Taitung Road）209/6号印刷店店主谭福生（Tan Hock Seng）告知侦探，鉴于已进行的调查，他在侦探离开后检查了宋耀山工作过的办公桌抽屉，并发现了

pages.en:
2/5.

some ammunition.
Detectives immediately accompanied the informant
to Tatung Road and seized from the drawer in question
32 rounds of pistol ammunition.
Enquiries proceeding.

J. Wilson

一些弹药。
侦探立即随举报人前往泰东路，并从上述抽屉中缴获了32发手枪子弹。
调查正在进行中。

Copy for D. C. Special Branch.
File. 572/40.
Room 334
28th August, '40.

Arrest of Male Chinese in Possession of Automatic Pistol and 12
Rounds of Ammunition.
D.S.I. Gibson.

Sir,

At 9.30 a.m. 28-8-40 a party of detectives
operating on Amoy Road observed a male Chinese loitering
near the entrance of Lane 50 Amoy Road.

The suspect was apprehended and on being searched
was found in possession of an automatic pistol, "Astra"
make, No. 259019, with one round of ammunition in the
breech and five rounds in the magazine. A second
magazine containing six rounds of ammunition also was
seized in possession of the arrested man.

On being brought to the station and questioned by
detectives the suspect gave his name as:-
Soong Yock San (宋玉山) age 31, native of Suchow,
married, no fixed abode.

He admitted that he was a Chungking Government
agent and that he had intended to assassinate a male
Chinese in Amoy Road.

In a statement the arrested man, Soong Yock San,
alleges that he has resided in Shanghai for eight months
as an agent of the Chungking Government.

He states that he receives instructions regarding
his duties from another agent whom he knows by the
name of "Lao" but whose real identity he does not know.

According to Soong Yock San, as a result of
instructions received from the agent, "Lao", he, Soong
Yock San, proceeded to a small village near Way King
(楊涇), Soochow, on the 16-8-40 when he received from
another unknown male Chinese the pistol and ammunition

（批：Recd / 26/8）
（批：S.B. (f)）
（批：C x i l k L）
（批：lmzble ops）
pages.zh:
特别处副主任副本。
档案号 572/40。
334室
1940年8月28日。

逮捕一名持有自动手枪及12发子弹的华籍男子。
侦探副督察 吉布森（D.S.I. Gibson）。

先生：

1940年8月28日上午9时30分，一组在厦门路（Amoy Road）行动的侦探观察到一名华籍男子在厦门路50弄入口附近徘徊。

嫌疑人被逮捕，经搜身发现其持有一支“阿斯特拉”（Astra）牌自动手枪，编号259019，枪膛内有一发子弹，弹匣内有五发子弹。在该被捕男子身上还缴获了另一个装有六发子弹的备用弹匣。

嫌疑人被带至警局并接受侦探讯问时，报出姓名为：
宋玉山（Soong Yock San），31岁，苏州人，已婚，无固定住所。

他承认自己是重庆政府特工，并意图在厦门路刺杀一名华籍男子。

在被捕男子宋玉山的供词中，他声称作为重庆政府特工在上海居住了八个月。

他表示，他从另一名代号为“老”（Lao）的特工那里接受任务指令，但他不知道此人的真实身份。

据宋玉山称，根据特工“老”的指示，他于1940年8月16日前往苏州杨泾（Way King，楊涇）附近的一个小村庄，并从另一名未知的华籍男子手中接收了手枪和弹药

（批注：收到 / 8月26日）
（批注：特别处 (f)）
（批注：C x i l k L）
（批注：lmzble ops [原文不清]）

pages.en:
(2)

which was seized by detectives.
Soong Yock San again met the other agent outside
the Wing On Co., at 7.00 a.m. 23-8-40 when he received
definite instructions regarding the person marked down
for assassination.
The name of the intended victim was not given but
a photograph and description of the man was furnished
together with the information that the victim usually
walked past Lane 50 Amoy Road every morning about 10 a.m.
On the 23-8-40 and 24-8-40 Soong Yock San kept
observation at Amoy Road and from the photograph and
description identified the person whom he had been
detailed to kill.
About 8.30 a.m. 25-8-40 Soong Yock San proceeded to
Amoy Road with the intention of carrying out his
appointed task but was arrested before he could commit
the crime.
Questioned regarding his associate, Soong Yock San,
averred that he had no knowledge of his whereabouts and
that contact was maintained by appointing a rendezvous
at each preceding meeting.
He states that on 23-8-40 an appointment was made
for 7 a.m. 26-8-40 outside the Great World, R.C.
Arrangements already have been made with the French
Police for assistance to be rendered and detectives will
escort Soong Yock San to the appointed meeting place
on 26-8-40 in an endeavour to arrest the accomplice.
The finger prints of Soong Yock San were submitted
to the Finger Print Bureau but examination revealed
pages.zh:
(2)

即被侦探缴获的那些。
1940年8月23日上午7时，宋玉山再次在永安公司（Wing On Co.）外与另一名特工会面，此时他收到了关于预定刺杀目标的明确指令。
未提供预定受害者的姓名，但提供了一张照片和对该男子的描述，并告知受害者通常每天上午10点左右会经过厦门路50弄。
1940年8月23日和24日，宋玉山在厦门路进行监视，并根据照片和描述认出了被指派杀害的目标人物。
1940年8月25日上午8时30分左右，宋玉山前往厦门路，意图执行指定任务，但在实施犯罪前被逮捕。
当被问及同伙时，宋玉山坚称不知晓其下落，并称双方通过每次会面时约定下一次见面地点来保持联系。
他称，1940年8月23日双方约定于1940年8月26日上午7时在法租界大世界（Great World, R.C.）外会面。
已与法国警察安排好协助事宜，侦探将于1940年8月26日护送宋玉山前往约定会面地点，试图逮捕其同伙。
宋玉山的指纹已提交至指纹局，但经查证显示

pages.en:
(3)

that
/he has no previous convictions.

The seized pistol and ammunition have been forwarded
to the Arms Identification Section where preliminary
examination revealed the weapon to have been licensed
by both French and Chinese Authorities under Lic.No.s
F.1760 and C.1305 respectively.

Efforts were made to learn from the French Police
the identity of the licensee, but this information was
not immediately available.

The arrested man denied knowing the name or abode
of the intended victim and further enquiries will be
necessary to establish his identity.

On the instructions of D.C.(Crime), Seong Yech San
is being detained at the station pending further
instructions.

Copies of statement by Seong Yech San attached.
Enquiries proceeding.

J. Gibson.
D. S. I.
C.I.D.S.S.

D. B. O. "A" DIVN.

Copy to Supdt. I/C. C.I. (direct).

(3)

他无前科记录。

查获的手枪和弹药已送至武器鉴定科，初步检查显示该武器分别由法国和中国当局核发执照，执照号码分别为 F.1760 和 C.1305。

曾试图从法国警察处查明持照人身份，但未能立即获得该信息。

被捕男子否认知晓预定受害者的姓名或住址，需进一步调查以确定其身份。

根据刑事处副主任（D.C.(Crime)）的指令，宋耀山（Seong Yech San）正被拘留在警局，等待进一步指示。

附宋耀山供词副本。
调查正在进行中。

J. Gibson.

pages.en:
Soong Yoch San (宋玉山)
D.S.I. Gibson
25/6/40.
zaushing

My name is Soong Yoch San (宋玉山), aged 31, native
of Zaushing, married, no fixed abode.
Formerly I was employed as a typesetter in a small
printing shop on Yangstepoo Road near Dalny Road. The
master of the business was one, Wong Ah Ding (王阿定).
After having been employed there for three years I was
thrown out of employment by the outbreak of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities in 1937.
I proceeded to my native place at Siao San (萧山)
Ningpo, and remained there until May 1939 when I returned
to Shanghai in search of employment.
I failed to obtain employment and became dependent
on friends for my board and lodging.
In September 1939 I met a friend, Tseu Ping Sung (周炳生)
who advised me that prospects of employment were greater
in Chungking.
Together with Tseu Ping Sung I proceeded to Chungking
via Hongkong arriving in Chungking about 25/10/39.
Through the recommendation of Tseu Ping Sung I became
employed by the Chungking Government as a government agent.
I received a salary of $40.00 per month.
In the early part of January 1940, acting on instructions
I returned to Shanghai. Prior to leaving Chungking I was
photographed and furnished an accommodation address through
which I might be contacted in Shanghai.
Shortly after my arrival in Shanghai I received a letter
pages.zh:
宋玉山（Soong Yoch San，宋玉山）
侦探副督察 吉布森（D.S.I. Gibson）
1940年6月25日。
zaushing [原文拼写错误，应为绍兴或类似地名，此处保留原文]

我叫宋玉山（Soong Yoch San，宋玉山），31岁，祖籍 Zaushing [原文不清，音译]，已婚，无固定住所。
此前我在大连路（Dalny Road）附近的杨树浦路（Yangstepoo Road）一家小印刷店担任排字工。店主名叫王阿定（Wong Ah Ding，王阿定）。
在那里工作三年后，由于1937年中日战事爆发，我失业了。
我回到宁波萧山（Siao San，萧山）老家，一直待到1939年5月，随后返回上海寻找工作。
我未能找到工作，依靠朋友资助食宿。
1939年9月，我遇到一位朋友周炳生（Tseu Ping Sung，周炳生），他建议我去重庆，那里的就业机会更多。
我与周炳生一同经香港前往重庆，于1939年10月25日左右抵达重庆。
经周炳生推荐，我受雇于重庆政府，担任政府特工。
我的月薪为40.00元。
1940年1月初，我奉命返回上海。在离开重庆之前，我拍摄了照片，并提供了一个通讯地址，以便在上海与我联系。
抵达上海后不久，我收到一封信

pages.en:
Sheet 2. 大之
at the accomodation address (c/o. Tah Nyue Printing Snop,
Kiukiang Road) and in which I was instructed to visit
平齐
Room No.5, Ping Chao Lodging House, Avenue Road.
Following the instructions I made contact with another
agent (identity unknown to me) who verified my identity
from the photograph taken in Chungking.
Since the first meeting I have maintained contact with the
unknown agent through the expedient of always appointing a
rendezvous at the previous meeting.
No arrangements were made to establish contact in the
event an appointment could not be kept.
At the end of July I wished to visit my home in Siao
San and informed the other agent of my intentions. He
then made an appointment to meet at 7 a.m. 15-8-40
outside the Great World, F.C.
I kept this appointment and received a photograph of a
male Chinese whom I was to be detailed to assassinate.
No information as to the identity of the intended victim
was furnished and I was instructed that I first must secure
a pistol.
I also was given $10.00 (transportation money) and a
letter with instructions to proceed to a small village
near Yang King(洋泾), Pootung, on 16-8-40.
I followed my instructions and while walking through
the village carrying the letter in my hand, I was accosted
by a male Chinese who, after establishing my identity,
pages.zh:
第2页。 大之 [原文手写标记]
在通讯地址（九江路泰月印刷店转交，c/o. Tah Nyue Printing Snop, Kiukiang Road），信中指示我前往
平齐 [原文手写标记，对应下文 Ping Chao]
爱多亚路（Avenue Road）平潮旅馆（Ping Chao Lodging House）5号房间。
遵照指示，我与另一名特工（身份不详）取得了联系，他通过在重庆拍摄的照片核实了我的身份。
自首次会面以来，我一直通过在前次会面时总是约定下次见面地点的方式与这名未知特工保持联系。
若无法赴约，并未安排其他联系方式。
7月底，我想回萧山老家探亲，并告知了另一名特工我的意图。随后他约定于1940年8月15日上午7时在法租界大世界（Great World, F.C.）外会面。
我如期赴约，并收到了一张华籍男子的照片，我被指派刺杀此人。
未提供关于预定受害者身份的任何信息，我接到的指令是必须先搞到一支手枪。
我还得到了10.00元（交通费）和一封信，指示我于1940年8月16日前往浦东洋泾（Yang King，洋泾）附近的一个小村庄。
我遵照指令，手持信件穿过村庄时，一名华籍男子与我搭讪，在核实我的身份后，

pages.en:
Sheet 3.

handed me a pistol and ammunition. He also conducted me
to an empty piece of ground where he instructed me in
the use of the weapon. I then returned to Shanghai.

Between 7.00 a.m. and 8.00 a.m. 18/8/40 I again met
the other agent on Canton Road near Honan Road and after
he learned that I had obtained the pistol he appointed
another meeting outside the Wing On Company, Nanking Road,
at 7.00 a.m. 23/8/40.

At this meeting I was furnished with the description of
the man whose photograph I already had received and whom I
was to assassinate.

I also was informed that the victim every day passes
Lane 50 Amoy Road and that I should carry out my assignment
at the first available opportunity.

The man from whom I received my instructions stated
that other agents would keep observation to see that I
carried out the assassination and that I should discard the
the pistol after the shooting.

We then separated after appointing a rendezvous outside
the Great World at 7.00 a.m. 24/8/40.

About 9.00 a.m. 23/8/40 I proceeded to Amoy Road and
about 10.00 a.m. observed the man whose photograph I had
received walking west to east along Amoy Road.

Again on 24/8/40 I observed the intended victim about
10.00 a.m. under similar circumstances.

Having established in my mind the identity of the person
whom I was to kill I discarded the photograph throwing it
pages.zh:
第3页。

递给我一支手枪和弹药。他还带我到一块空地，指导我如何使用该武器。随后我返回上海。

1940年8月18日上午7时至8时之间，我在河南路附近的广东路再次与另一名特工会面，在他得知我已搞到手枪后，约定于1940年8月23日上午7时在南京路永安公司外再次会面。

在这次会面中，我获得了此前已收到照片的那名男子的描述，此人即我要刺杀的目标。

我还被告知，受害者每天都会经过厦门路50弄，我应抓住第一个可用机会执行任务。

向我下达指令的人表示，其他特工会进行监视，以确保我实施刺杀，并指示我在开枪后丢弃手枪。

随后我们分开，并约定于1940年8月24日上午7时在大世界外会面。

1940年8月23日上午9时左右，我前往厦门路，约上午10时观察到我所持照片上的那名男子沿厦门路由西向东行走。

1940年8月24日，我在类似情况下于上午10时左右再次观察到预定受害者。

在脑海中确认了我要杀害之人的身份后，我丢弃了照片，将其扔
